issue_context.title: Cannot read delta table containing parquet map type (Delta table created using Databricks Delta Live Tables framework)
issue_context.body:
### Checks

- [X] I have checked that this issue has not already been reported.
- [X] I have confirmed this bug exists on the [latest version](https://pypi.org/project/polars/) of Polars.

### Reproducible example

```python
df = pl.scan_delta(
    source=f"az://{container}/{schema}/tables/{table_name_without_schema}",
    storage_options=storage_options,
)
```


### Log output

```shell
thread '<unnamed>' panicked at crates/polars-core/src/datatypes/field.rs:188:19:
Arrow datatype Map(Field { name: "entries", dtype: Struct([Field { name: "key", dtype: Utf8, is_nullable: false, metadata: {} }, Field { name: "value", dtype: Boolean, is_nullable: true, metadata: {} }]), is_nullable: false, metadata: {} }, false) not supported by Polars. You probably need to activate that data-type feature.
```


### Issue description

Delta table made using the Delta Live Tables framework in Databricks (with the `apply_changes` [functionality](https://docs.databricks.com/en/delta-live-tables/python-ref.html#cdc)) cannot be read using Polars `scan_delta`. Works fine on other tables made in Databricks, but not those made using the `apply_changes` method.

### Expected behavior

Expected to scan the Delta table correctly.

### Installed versions

<details>

```
--------Version info---------
Polars:              1.12.0
Index type:          UInt32
Platform:            Linux-5.15.0-1074-azure-x86_64-with-glibc2.31
Python:              3.10.8 (main, Nov 24 2022, 07:41:17) [GCC 9.4.0]
LTS CPU:             False

----Optional dependencies----
adbc_driver_manager  <not installed>
altair               <not installed>
cloudpickle          3.1.0
connectorx           <not installed>
deltalake            0.20.2
fastexcel            <not installed>
fsspec               2024.6.1
gevent               <not installed>
great_tables         <not installed>
matplotlib           <not installed>
nest_asyncio         1.6.0
numpy                2.1.2
openpyxl             3.1.2
pandas               2.2.3
pyarrow              18.0.0
pydantic             <not installed>
pyiceberg            <not installed>
sqlalchemy           2.0.28
torch                <not installed>
xlsx2csv             <not installed>
xlsxwriter           <not installed>
```

</details>
comments: It's due Polars not supporting Arrow datatype Map. Delta Tables with other types will work fine.
This makes sense. Just a bit of a shame, since one of the key features of being able to read Delta is to use it with our existing Databricks Delta Lake environment
Polars should read `ArrowDataType::Map` just fine. It will convert it to a `Struct { key, value }`. This is a bug in my books.

> It's a [feature](https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/blob/247f0b17042401551af77205bcf28e4e739887c8/crates/polars-core/src/datatypes/field.rs#L234) not a bug. :)

https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/blob/247f0b17042401551af77205bcf28e4e739887c8/crates/polars-parquet/src/arrow/read/schema/metadata.rs#L69

Here is why it should be converted.

`LargeList` is `ArrowDataType` and the conversion works fine.
But somehow we still need to convert `ArrowDataType::Map` to `polars_core::datatypes::dtype` [here](https://github.com/pola-rs/polars/blob/247f0b17042401551af77205bcf28e4e739887c8/crates/polars-core/src/datatypes/field.rs#L234).
Otherwise we get:
```
polars.exceptions.SchemaError: dtypes differ for column account_id: LargeList(Field { name: "entries", dtype: Struct([Field { name: "key", dtype: Int32, is_nullable: false, metadata: None }, Field { name: "value", dtype: Utf8View, is_nullable: true, metadata: None }]), is_nullable: false, metadata: None }) != Null
```

I have tried:
```
ArrowDataType::Map(field, is_sorted) => {
     DataType::List(DataType::from_arrow_field(field).boxed())
 },
```
But it panics with:

```
thread 'polars-6' panicked at crates/polars-parquet/src/arrow/read/deserialize/nested.rs:450:25:
assertion `left == right` failed
```

 Any help would be appreciated. Thx

I have used this code to create a sample Delta table with map field. No need to Spark here.

```python
import pyarrow as pa
from deltalake import write_deltalake

payload = [{"id": 1, "account_id": {17: "100.01.001 Cash"} },
           {"id": 2, "account_id": {18: "180.01.001 Cash", 19: "foo"}}]

schema = pa.schema([
        pa.field("id", pa.int32()),
        pa.field("account_id", pa.map_(pa.int32(), pa.string())),
    ])
table = pa.Table.from_pylist(payload, schema)

table_path = "./tmp/my_table"
write_deltalake(table_path, table,mode="overwrite",engine="rust",)
```
Then tried to read it using Polars:

```python
import polars as pl

table_path = "./tmp/my_table"
df = pl.scan_delta(table_path)
print(df.collect_schema())
print(df.collect())
```
